div.head: Northu 8
div.ab: Gif preost fulluhtes oððe scriftes forwyrne, gebete þæt mid XII ór ⁊ huru wið God þingige georne.
If a priest refuses any baptism or confession, he is to pay 12 ores compensation for it, and above all to make zealous supplication to God.
If a priest refuses to perform baptism or confession, he is to compensate for that with twelve ores and most especially plead fervently with God.
Wenn ein Pfarrer Taufe oder Beichte verweigert, büsse er das durch 12 Ör und sühne vor allem ernstlich gegenüber Gott.
If a priest refuses baptism or confession, let him atone for it with 12 ores and above all make earnest amends with God.
div.note: Liebermann compares the Canons of Edgar.
